title: Miley Cyrus & Maxx Morando’s Wedding Photos Are Here
summary: The couple were married in Palm Springs, Calif., on Saturday (Nov. 21).
body: Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando’s wedding pictures are here. The bride and groom shared the first official look at their marriage ceremony on Sunday, the day after their intimate Saturday (Nov. 21) event in Palm Springs, Calif. Related Miley Cyrus Marries Maxx Morando in Poolside Ceremony Led by the Flaming Lips’ Wayne Coyne Miley Cyrus and Fiancé Maxx Morando Are Blissfully Alone in a Beautiful Crowd in Loved-Up ‘Let’s Get Married’ Video: Watch Miley Cyrus Reacts to Shared Grammy Nod With Dolly Parton: ‘A Beautiful Way to Honor Her Enormous Heart’ Cyrus posted four wedding photos on Instagram along with the caption “M + M 11.21.26” surrounding a white heart emoji. Photographer Jose Villa was credited for the images. The newlyweds’ portraits are in black and white, matching the timeless elegance of Cyrus’ long-sleeved, silk Saint Laurent gown with a train and Morando’s classic black tux — which he accessorized with his signature dark shades.
